verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a desktop terminal emulator, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics, or any opt-out setting. Ghostty's many configuration options are not evidence of a telemetry control, so this is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
